lines.text: Mira... I've never recorded a single message.
[quiet] One day left. I finally asked him what future him knows.
[confused, gentle] Mira... I've never recorded a single message. Not one.
[stunned] He showed me his phone. Nothing sent. Nothing at eleven eleven.
lines.show: He showed me his phone. Nothing sent. Nothing at 11:11.

lines.text: [uneasy, low] And the ones in your voice... you didn't send those either. Did you?
[low] So who has been talking to us?
[soft] That night, we sat on his floor, my head on his shoulder. Waiting.
[frozen] Both phones lit up. The same number.
